verificationNotes: Only one Nucet monastery in Dâmbovița (OSM node 1316063083 'Mănăstirea Nucet'). The church outline is untagged OSM way 1441634148 (29 x 13 m, E-W) right at the node (7 m), with an inner polygonal tower part 1441634147; the larger 65 x 38 m outline 1441634154 is the cells/precinct. Church founded late 15th c. (Gherghina Pârcălab), rebuilt 1840, damaged by earthquakes (ro.wikipedia commune article). Agerpres (2026) says the monastic ensemble underwent extensive restoration at the archbishop's initiative and was re-consecrated in 2004; no public source found on the 2015 copper roof itself; a January 2022 fire hit the cells' roof, not the church.
